verdict.rationale: Postman ships in-product AI. Agent Mode works on your requests and responses through natural language: it can fix errors, update or add tests, visualize responses and write documentation. Postbot is a usage-limited AI assistant available on all plans and as a paid add-on. These are suggestion- and action-oriented, but no evidence describes AI explicitly surfacing insights or analysis from user data such as response, test or analytics data. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of AI-generated insights or analysis over user data, a description of what Postbot actually suggests, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the quality of its suggestions.
